description: Four independent cured carbon/epoxy materials: orthotropic upper/lower skins and plane-isotropic equivalent leading/trailing edges. Numerical defaults are reference proxies, not measured wing properties.

assumptions: Effective cured wet-layup reference includes epoxy; this is not raw carbon-fiber stiffness or strength.
E1=E2 and equal warp/fill strengths are balanced-fabric approximations. They remain separately editable.
G13=G23=2.34 GPa is an explicit unmeasured transverse-shear assumption.
Rounded RTD strength proxies: Xt=Yt=390 MPa, Xc=Yc=373 MPa, S=97.4 MPa, from AGATE report p24 measured B-basis entries; these are NOT verified allowables for this wing.
Upper/lower start from the same reference numbers but have separate definitions and MAT8 IDs; edits never propagate between regions.
Strengths do not alter linear elastic stiffness. PCOMP failure theory remains blank; no strength pass/fail is inferred.

User-requested in-plane isotropic homogenization. Crossing 0/90 fibers alone does not establish isotropy.
E and nu derived from orientation-averaging the reference cured woven plane-stress stiffness; G12 is computed as E/[2(1+nu)].
This is an effective membrane-property approximation, not measured edge properties or exact ply-by-ply bending equivalence.
G13/G23 remain independent assumed transverse-shear moduli; plane isotropy does not require full 3D isotropy.
Leading and trailing edges have separate definitions and MAT8 IDs even when initial numbers match.
No edge strength allowables assigned. Elastic isotropy alone does not establish an isotropic failure envelope.
